name: recurday
description: Recurday Day-1: family traditions, kept and rewatched year by year.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-static.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply recurday --local && wrangler dev
scripts.test: node scripts/build-static.mjs --check && node test/calendar.test.mjs && node test/scale.test.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build-static.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply recurday --remote && wrangler deploy
